description: The hem, and no new doors

participation.context: Refused a new lady and named himself Egeon for the afternoon.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Asked for a tall angry lady and agreed to stand where the plot put him.
participation.name: Arthur Meeks

participation.context: Left the doors as they were and refused a third house.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

relations.note: the hem, and no new lady
relations.quote: Make the next lady tall and angry about it!

story.body: You took Arthur's complaint and did not write a part to fit it. You kept the doors as they were.

title: Heard Arthur ask for a taller lady

participation.context: Refused a new door and said he is off tomorrow's bill.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Asked for a better door and did not get one.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Named tomorrow's Shrew and Thursday's ten shillings apiece.
participation.name: John Heminges

relations.note: three lines and the door the play already has
relations.quote: You have left me three lines and a door.

story.body: You refused a new door. You agreed you are not in tomorrow's Shrew, and you did not cancel it for the company.
